Sony_Live.method: Original white SONY and gold liv pixels extracted; hidden background Laplace-inpainted; visible original purple flow and circular alpha fixed. Not square-card replacement.
Sony_Live.limitations: Original flattened raster has no exact concealed flow. Laplace recovery under original letters is approximate. Original lettering RGB, visible purple-flow background and circular presentation are retained; downloaded square-card replacement is not used.
Sony_Live.qa: Actual 280px and36px before/after reviewed. Alpha identical; visible background outside original matte unchanged; identity opaque reconstruction max error0.

Xbox.evidence: Existing official source is one RGBA bitmap embedded in SVG, not independent X/background geometry. X-shaped gaps are transparent negative space between green shaded sphere segments. Current accepted implementation scales the whole official sphere, not a fabricated isolated white X.
Xbox.recommendation: Use complete official transparent sphere at scale 0.70 on fixed white disc, as explicitly accepted by parent. Earlier recommendation to retain legacy full-circle presentation is superseded.

negative_space_evidence.observation: Actual image viewed: four green shaded sphere segments, transparent X-shaped gaps. White X in legacy appearance is backing showing through, not an independent official white glyph layer.

Xbox.supersedes: Earlier preserve_original_disc recommendation in this report; retain negative-space observations as factual evidence.
